inventory.dec2_resolution: useD2Detail.importFromAuxBalance(projectId) does NOT hit any d2/import-aux-balance endpoint. It calls the GENERIC read endpoint /ledger/aux-balance-detail with a HARDCODED account_code=1122 and dim_type=客户, then aggregates by aux_name CLIENT-SIDE (a 5th归集 copy in TypeScript). The read endpoint itself IS铁律-compliant (get_active_filter + aux_type==dim_type + account_code LIKE prefix). The violations live in the D2 FRONTEND: (③) hardcoded 1122 instead of resolving from report mapping (D2_SPEC/BS-006 already exists in d_account_resolver.py), and it bypasses the shared aggregate_aux_by_name pipeline. Therefore D2 = G-C: migrate to a proper POST /api/workpapers/{wp_id}/d2/import-aux-balance backend endpoint built on the shared component, drive account prefix from D2_SPEC(BS-006), and remove the client-side aggregation.

blocked_deferred.finding: The detail-row persistence subsets for D1/D2/D3/D5/D6/D7/F1/K1 do NOT carry unified source metadata (source_kind / source_dataset_id). Grep across use{D1,D2,D3,D5,D6,D7,F1}Detail.ts + useK1DetailAutoSeed.ts found NONE. Only useK1Adjustment.ts carries sourceKind, and that is the K1 ADJUSTMENT-entries item — a different store item, not the detail rows this spec touches.
blocked_deferred.decision: Per design DEC-4, this spec does NOT add unified source metadata to detail rows (it would alter 5+ cycle store shapes and contract digests). Therefore, per Requirement 5.4, ALL G-A/G-B/G-C rows are delivered WITHOUT unified source_kind/source_dataset_id and this capability is registered here as a DEFERRED enhancement (not a blocker for extraction itself). Downstream Task 9 evidence should record source_dataset_id from the endpoint response context even though it is not persisted in the row.
blocked_deferred.escalation_condition: If Task 4/5/7 discovers that a target cycle CANNOT even carry the extraction rows themselves (row structure absent), that cycle must be marked blocked/deferred and EXCLUDED from the final completion count. As of this inventory, all listed hosts satisfy T3 (carriable rows), so none is blocked on that basis.

g_d_register.note: No wp_code in the aux-balance detail-table family was classified G-D in this inventory. The spec scope (per design) is the aux-balance (往来单位/维度) detail-table hosts. Hosts outside this family (e.g. pure journal-based P&L cycles, confirmation bundles K0, report/summary components) are OUT OF SCOPE for aux extraction and are intentionally not enumerated as candidates — they fail capability tuple T2/T3 for the aux grain (data in tb_ledger not tb_aux_balance, or no per-单位 row structure). Registering an explicit empty G-D honors 宁缺勿造: no host was force-fit an entry.
